checks.name: Small original archives retain the unchanged R24 length, hash and path guards
Oversized archive declarations and traversal are refused before any network call
A large stream ending early or exceeding its declaration is refused and cancelled
A complete original-sized stream above 40 MiB is accepted only with its exact SHA-256
Large archives require a bounded streaming body
Dossier header remains available when optional DOM or fetch capabilities are absent
Source position links round-trip native floating-point time without action aliases or autoplay
Changed hashes, duplicate parameters, wrong clips and invalid/out-of-range positions are refused
Aborting a streamed archive cancels its reader before bytes can be accepted
